data_exposure: All SOXL evaluation outcomes already examined. This is a retrospective exploratory extension, not an independent holdout. No 2026 SOXL prices requested.
unchanged: Same exact prior SIP sessions, gap signal, 09:32 entry, 10:00 exit, 25% current equity allocation, initial 100000, costs 0/2/5/10bp each side; no stops, targets or sizing changes
major_definition: Top five equity issuers by value in latest publicly filed SOXX portfolio snapshot; SOXX SEC series S000004354, class C000012084, CIK1100663. Not today's constituents or ex-post biggest price movers. Rank equity only; aggregate duplicate issuer positions. Ties by canonical issuer name.
holdings_availability: Use snapshot only on exchange sessions whose date is strictly after its SEC filing date; carry latest available publication. NPORT-P plus historical N-Q/N-CSR/N-CSRS as needed. Report snapshot age; never silently equate disclosed lagged holdings to exact contemporaneous daily weights. Unknown holdings coverage blocks classification, not silently no event.
event_definition: Quarterly/annual earnings release of a selected major issuer, supported by issuer releases or SEC results filings. SEC submission reportDate/Item2.02 alone is a candidate, not automatically a verified release date. Filing timestamp is not assumed to equal release timestamp. Publish resolved events and unresolved candidates.
selection_time: Determine major membership using latest holdings publicly filed strictly before the announcement calendar date, then freeze membership for its blackout dates; do not reselect for next session after seeing returns.
primary_blackout: ANNOUNCEMENT_AND_NEXT_SESSION: exclude announcement's NY calendar date if a session, plus first exchange session strictly after it. Conservative treatment covering unknown release time and overnight reaction; no guessed before/after-market classification.
sensitivity: ANNOUNCEMENT_ONLY: exclude only actual announcement NY calendar day if an exchange session; NEXT_SESSION_ONLY: exclude first session strictly after announcement. All reported; no winner chosen by results. These are date conventions of one filter, not altered entry strategies.
calendar: XNYS 4.13.2; weekends, holidays and half days handled by calendar, no calendar-day +1 assumption
unknown_policy: Do not replace missing events with no earnings. If a complete event history cannot be verified, narrow explicitly to supported interval and compare its identical unfiltered baseline; retain full-period blocked status. No invented or forecast dates.
accounting: Keep all original valid sessions in equity/bootstrap calendar; blackout produces side=0, trade return=0 and portfolio return=0. Recompute compounded equity independently, never subtract removed dollar PnL from old final equity. Pair baseline and filtered sessions exactly.
diagnostics: All original four arms and cost scenarios; compare retained vs removed trades, win rate, mean net trade bps, profit factor, drawdown, final equity, year and original time partitions. Original 09:31 boundary is only supplementary; never promote it silently.
asof_limitation: Actual historical release dates alone do not prove those future dates were scheduled and known at entry; absent archived schedule announcements, this remains event-conditioned retrospective sensitivity, not deployable point-in-time earnings-calendar proof.
scope: Research only; no Paper/live orders, no changes to original src/dx27 or prior research results
search: No top-N, gap, stop, timing or earnings-window optimization. Every fixed date convention and negative result published.
